plan.title: Psoriasis lesional vs control hallmark enrichment (fgsea)
plan.analytical_narrative: DE is already done (DESeq2 treated-vs-control results table de_results.csv, 12000 genes, 6 vs 6). The research question is narrowly about which hallmark pathways change, and the enrichment_input is a ranked list, so per the knowledge-service procedure (R-0107, R-0045, R-0099, R-0108) the correct step is a preranked fgsea against MSigDB Hallmark, ranked on the DESeq2 Wald statistic (stat column) rather than the unshrunken log2FC or a signed p-value (both of which are flagged as unreliable ranking metrics). A lightweight QC pass on the raw counts precedes the enrichment because the counts and metadata are supplied alongside the results table (R-0110: a sample-level check of delivered counts precedes enrichment when counts are delivered too), and the profile flags sample_01 at ~4x below median library size, which needs to be surfaced before the enrichment result is interpreted (it does not, however, block enrichment since DE was already computed upstream). Reactome runs as the stated second-collection follow-up (R-0098). No new differential expression model is fit — this is an enrichment-on-delivered-results workflow, not a DE re-run.
